caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular rug with a primarily tan or beige background. The center features a floral arrangement consisting of five large flowers, primarily in shades of red and orange, with accompanying green leaves of various shapes and sizes. Surrounding the floral motif, the rug has a decorative border with multiple parallel lines in reddish-brown, purple, and tan hues. At each corner of the rug, there are geometric elements resembling stylized L-shapes or Greek keys, rendered in muted red and gray-green colors. The entire composition has a symmetrical layout, with the floral design centrally positioned and the geometric corners mirrored on all four sides. The outermost edge of the rug is bordered with a thin dark line.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
